-- .gitignore --
# The environments' var files hold no secret values (see README.md):
# commit them.
!vars/**/*.tfvars
-- README.md --
# aws/eu-west-2

Generated by infraharvest: one root whose code every environment shares (dev, prod). What differs between them is in `vars/<env>/`: `terraform.tfvars` holds the values that differ from the defaults in `variables.tf`, `imports.tfvars` the IDs `imports.tf` imports, and `backend.hcl` where the state is kept.

| Environment | `env` | Account | Region |
|---|---|---|---|
| dev | `dev` | 111111111111 | eu-west-2 |
| prod | `prd` | 222222222222 | eu-west-2 |

## Plan and apply an environment

Run each environment with its own credentials: the provider block sets no role of its own. For dev, and likewise for the others:

```sh
terraform init
terraform workspace select -or-create dev
terraform plan -var-file=vars/common.tfvars -var-file=vars/dev/terraform.tfvars -var-file=vars/dev/imports.tfvars
terraform apply -var-file=vars/common.tfvars -var-file=vars/dev/terraform.tfvars -var-file=vars/dev/imports.tfvars
```

Without a backend, each environment keeps its state in the workspace named after it, in `terraform.tfstate.d/<env>/`, which `infraharvest drift` reads. Plan each environment before its first apply: it should import every resource and change nothing else.

## After the first apply

Once every environment has been applied, delete `imports.tf` and each `vars/<env>/imports.tfvars`, and leave `-var-file=vars/<env>/imports.tfvars` out of the commands.
-- imports.tf --
# Each environment imports its resources on its first apply, with their IDs
# from vars/<env>/imports.tfvars. Delete this file, and those, after it.

import {
  for_each = local.lambda_functions

  to = aws_lambda_function.this[each.key]
  id = var.import_ids[format("aws_lambda_function.this[%q]", each.key)]
}

import {
  for_each = local.lambda_function_lambda_functions

  to = aws_lambda_function.this_2[each.key]
  id = var.import_ids[format("aws_lambda_function.this_2[%q]", each.key)]
}

-- main.tf --
resource "aws_lambda_function" "this" {
  for_each = local.lambda_functions

  function_name = each.value.function_name
  handler       = "index.handler"
  runtime       = "nodejs20.x"

  tracing_config {
    mode = "Active"
  }
}

resource "aws_lambda_function" "this_2" {
  for_each = local.lambda_function_lambda_functions

  function_name = each.value.function_name
  handler       = "index.handler"
  runtime       = "nodejs21.x"

  tracing_config {
    mode = "PassThrough"
  }
}

resource "aws_lambda_function" "this_3" {
  for_each = local.lambda_function_lambda_functions_2

  function_name = each.value.function_name

    mode = "Active"
  }
}

-- providers.tf --
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.7, < 2.0"

  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 6.14"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region              = var.aws_region
  allowed_account_ids = var.allowed_account_ids
}
-- variables.tf --
variable "env" {
  description = "The token that stands for the environment in names."
  type        = string

  validation {
    condition     = contains(["dev", "prd"], var.env)
    error_message = "env must be one of dev, prd."
  }
}

variable "aws_region" {
  description = "The AWS region of the stack."
  type        = string
  default     = "eu-west-2"
}

variable "allowed_account_ids" {
  description = "The allowed_account_ids of the aws provider."
  type        = list(string)
}

variable "deploy_q17" {
  description = "Whether the environment has aws_sqs_queue.q17."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "deploy_q59" {
  description = "Whether the environment has aws_sqs_queue.q59."
  type        = bool
  default     = false
}

variable "sqs_queue_policies" {
  description = "The instances of aws_sqs_queue_policy.this in the environment, by key."
  type        = map(object({}))
}

variable "sqs_queue_policy_sqs_queue_policies" {
  description = "The instances of aws_sqs_queue_policy.this_2 in the environment, by key."
  type        = map(object({}))
}

variable "sqs_queue_policy_sqs_queue_policies_2" {
  description = "The instances of aws_sqs_queue_policy.this_3 in the environment, by key."
  type        = map(object({}))
}

variable "sqs_queue_sqs_queues" {
  description = "The instances of aws_sqs_queue.this_2 in the environment, by key."
  type        = map(object({ kms_master_key_id = optional(string), name = optional(string) }))
}

variable "sqs_queue_sqs_queues_2" {
  description = "The instances of aws_sqs_queue.this_3 in the environment, by key."
  type        = map(object({ kms_master_key_id = optional(string), name = optional(string) }))
}

variable "sqs_queue_sqs_queues_3" {
  description = "The instances of aws_sqs_queue.this_4 in the environment, by key."
  type        = map(object({ max_message_size = optional(number), name = optional(string) }))
}

variable "sqs_queue_sqs_queues_4" {
  description = "The instances of aws_sqs_queue.this_5 in the environment, by key."
  type        = map(object({ kms_master_key_id = optional(string), name = optional(string) }))
}

variable "sqs_queues" {
  description = "The instances of aws_sqs_queue.this in the environment, by key."
  type        = map(object({ max_message_size = optional(number), name = optional(string) }))
}

variable "import_ids" {
  description = "The import ID of each resource the environment imports, by its address: vars/<env>/imports.tfvars sets it for imports.tf."
  type        = map(string)
  default     = {}
}
-- vars/common.tfvars --
# Values every environment shares, which the defaults in variables.tf don't
# give: none yet. Each environment's own are in vars/<env>/terraform.tfvars.
